content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 The IOC implementation shall be part of the Operating System The IOC is a third type of communication, in addition to • Intra OS-Application communication: Always handled within the RTE • Inter ECU communication: Already available via well-defined interfaces to the communication stack (COM)
